title: Distinguish grantless busy sessions from Engram checkpoint-owner timeouts
outcome: A reset checkpoint candidate with no active grant but bind/pending work can remain in the claim loop and be reported as waiting on another checkpoint owner. Strict mode may abort a reset and best-effort mode may write a misleading degraded card even though there was no grant to checkpoint.
acceptance: Checkpoint arbitration distinguishes no active grant, bind/pending work, and another checkpoint owner; grantless sessions do not produce owner-timeout wording or spurious degraded cards; strict and best-effort deterministic tests cover each state.
